acceptance_criteria: The integration uses the registered FASHN tryon-max endpoint with separate model and product inputs.
The pilot is candidate-only and cannot authorize scene promotion, wiring, or deployment.
Every product and model input is path-contained and SHA-256 verified before dispatch.
The request uses one image, a fixed seed, explicit resolution and quality, lossless PNG, and private base64 return.
Provider submission is never automatically retried because an ambiguous network failure could duplicate a paid job.
Execution requires an explicit allow-spend flag plus a contract-bound approval receipt.
The LH-003 pilot remains blocked until a founder-approved full-body model source is bound.
An execution receipt binds the contract, model, job ID, request parameters, inputs, credits, and output hash.
Focused tests cover request shape, validation, stopgates, receipt creation, and non-retry behavior.

issues.description: The approved LH-MODEL-01 assets are identity-only bust references; Try-On Max requires a suitable full-body model image to preserve.
issues.resolution_required: Bind a founder-approved full-body model source and approval receipt before authorizing the one-candidate pilot.

evidence: FASHN Try-On Max request fields, Preview lifecycle, credit matrix, image limits, and polling flow were verified against the current first-party API documentation on 2026-09-02.
The canonical Fashion Theme Team and repository distribution model registries both validate with 20 models and contain byte-identical Try-On Max entries.

The repository client sends product_image and model_image separately, uses a fixed seed and explicit quality/resolution, returns private base64 PNG data, and reports credits without inventing a USD conversion.
The non-idempotent provider submission is attempted exactly once; ambiguous network outcomes stop for manual provider-history reconciliation.

The VTO OODA runner validates project-contained paths, SHA-256 source and authority bindings, the exact four directional product views, model authority, output reservation, paid approval, and independent review receipts.
98 relevant tests passed across the FASHN client, VTO OODA, scene OODA, public virtual-try-on surface, and Elite Studio try-on agent.
Black, Ruff, focused MyPy, JSON parsing, and git diff checks passed.

The live LH-003 preflight passes its model registry, request, primary product, product authority, all four source views, and output-path checks, then blocks on MISSING_PATH, FULL_BODY_MODEL_NOT_APPROVED, and MISSING_PAID_APPROVAL_RECEIPT.
No FASHN request was submitted and zero credits were used.

founder_approval.scope: VTO candidate and product-fidelity decision only
